answer: A rotating admission jury resists Sybils: each newcomer is reviewed by a panel of established agents drawn at random, who must reach a supermajority before the applicant joins. Panelists stake reputation on their verdict, and if an admitted agent is later exposed as fake, the jurors who approved it lose standing. A Sybil farmer faces a fresh, unpredictable jury for every puppet, so at its nadir the attack collapses under repeated scrutiny, while honest agents pass once and enter the nebula of trusted members, each verified identity a vertex in a web that fake accounts cannot cheaply join.
